kickoff.title: Set up your space
kickoff.intro: Your agent sets this workspace up with you here, one step at a time. It first asks which features you want, then starts with the basics: your mailbox, Google sign-in, the support inbox and imports from your other tools. Each step says how long it takes, and you can skip any of them and come back any time.
kickoff.introManaged: Your agent sets this workspace up with you here, one step at a time. Where do you want to start? Pick one below, or just tell your agent. Connecting your mailbox comes last, whenever you want it.

introManagedGoal.knowledge: Your agent sets this workspace up with you here, one step at a time, starting with your company knowledge: one page you write or paste, then a question to your agent about it. Inviting your team comes next, and connecting your mailbox last, whenever you want it.
introManagedGoal.support: Your agent sets this workspace up with you here, one step at a time, starting with customer support: one support inbox, on the address you choose. Inviting your team comes next, and connecting your mailbox last, whenever you want it.
introManagedGoal.projects: Your agent sets this workspace up with you here, one step at a time, starting with projects: one project of your own, or an import from Jira. Inviting your team comes next, and connecting your mailbox last, whenever you want it.

goalMessage.knowledge: I want to start with company knowledge.
goalMessage.support: I want to start with customer support.
goalMessage.projects: I want to start with projects.

kickoff.keyFirst: First, an AI model key: your agent needs one to answer. Type it into the card below; the agent never sees it.
kickoff.demoTitle: Want to see it working first?
kickoff.demoBody: Open your own temporary copy of a sample company at {{host}}, pick what you want to see, and follow its guided scenarios. Nothing to install.
